1) Concert of Taylor Swift in New York with VIP Seating.

2) Concert of Ed Sheeran in Los Angeles with Backstage Pass AND Parking Pass.

But note that add_ons type can accept either single or array? The definition says add_ons?: "Backstage Pass" | "VIP Seating" | "Parking Pass"[]. That seems ambiguous; maybe it's an array of strings from those options. For multiple add-ons we need to provide list ["Backstage Pass", "Parking Pass"].

Similarly third booking: Festival Coachella in Indio with Camping Pass and Parking Pass. So call festival_book_ticket with add_ons=["Camping Pass","Parking Pass"]. But default is Camping Pass so but they want both.

We should use two separate calls. We might combine them into one response? Usually each function invocation separately. We'll do first call, second call, third call sequentially.
